messages:
maya: FYI PR 4627 updates Console -> Observability docs: migrating dashboard cost/latency example from tracehook v1 to tracehook v2. Need quick sanity check for Node + Python snippets and the embed link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4627 :eyes:

sam: I skimmed — major change is param rename `trace_key` -> `trace_id` and the SDK import path. I can fix Node sample, but need to run the snippet locally.

jordan: I'll take Python. Also found a broken link in the dashboard YAML example (line ~42). Will push commit to the PR.

sam: Node snippet change: replace `const { startTrace } = require('@redwood/tracehook')` with `import { startTrace } from '@redwood/tracehook/v2'` and use `startTrace({ trace_id: ctx.trace })` :thumbsup:

maya: Can you paste the minimal Node example inline? reviewers want runnable snippet.

sam: Sure:
```js
import { startTrace } from '@redwood/tracehook/v2'
const run = async (req) => {
  const trace = startTrace({ trace_id: req.headers['x-rw-trace'] })
  await doWork()
  trace.finish()
}
```

jordan: Python diff I pushed uses `from redwood_tracehook.v2 import Trace` and `Trace.start(trace_id=...)`. Also swapped `trace.ctx` -> `trace.metadata['trace_id']` in examples. tests/manual run passed.

ivan: deploy-bot shows CI flaky on snippet linting — `prettier` error in the JS fenced block. Might need triple backticks with language tag and run `npm run format` in the docs repo.

deploy-bot: CI update: docs/4627 — build passed except `docs/snippets/node/cost-example.js` lint. See https://ci.redwood.ai/4627

maya: Thanks. Jordan, can you add a short note under "Migration notes" explaining the rename and why we changed to v2 import? One sentence is fine.

jordan: done, pushed.

maya: Last ask: can someone verify the dashboard JSON embed path? It used `/static/examples/old-cost.json` which I replaced with `/static/examples/cost-latency-v2.json` but want a double-check that file exists.

sam: I confirmed file exists in the branch. LGTM from my side after formatting fix. I can approve after CI green.

maya: @sam @jordan please approve when CI is green. I'll merge once both approvals and CI pass. Thanks!

sam: Approving now :white_check_mark:

jordan: Approved :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: CI update: docs/4627 — all checks passed. Merge available.

maya: Merged. Thanks everyone — small follow-up to add entries to the release notes for tracehook v2 migration.
